scope: ioi.ai portal identity to deployment-local Hypervisor daemon session

verified_properties: HS256 signature with a 32-byte minimum key
exact configured org:// or project:// tenant
daemon-owned principal and live tenant-membership resolution
five-minute hash-at-rest daemon session retained only by the BFF
production refusal of browser daemon-cookie or bearer fallback

release_blockers.reason: CLOSED. resolve_principal now narrows a portal-exchanged session to its admitted source_tenant_ref on every request and returns None when that membership is no longer live, so cross-tenant reach and post-revocation access both fail closed. Proven by portal_session_tenant_scope_binds_every_request_and_revocation_fails_closed.

CLOSED. The assertion admits an optional `act` claim into its closed claim set, refuses a malformed or self-referential actor, retains it as source_actor_ref on the session, and surfaces it as acting_principal_ref + is_impersonated on the resolved principal, so evidence binds actor AND subject. Proven by impersonated_session_retains_actor_beside_the_subject.
principal uniqueness uses permissive registry reads that may skip malformed or unreadable records
single-use custody is local to one shared data directory, and exchange/session records lack clustered custody, bounded garbage collection, and per-principal singleflight
real BFF-to-Axum HTTP, middleware bypass, parallel replay, tenant revocation, cross-tenant, impersonation, and corrupt-registry cases are not yet covered

operational_followups.reason: Expired replay-consumption and authentication-session records remain durable after they cease granting access.
operational_followups.closure_requires: A daemon-owned, race-safe retention policy may remove an exchange consumption only after assertion expiry plus the accepted clock-skew window, and may remove a session only after session expiry.

canonical_blocker.reason: Canon does not yet register a portable multi-issuer surface-identity exchange envelope, trust-registry lifecycle, key rotation/revocation object, or conformance contract.
canonical_blocker.bounded_effect: The implemented protocol is deployment-local, single-issuer, configuration-bound, and must not be presented as portable federation or machine authority.
closure_requires: canonical assertion and consumption receipt schemas
trusted surface issuer and key rotation/revocation owner ruling
conformance coverage for rotation, revocation, clock skew, and clustered replay custody
